title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ServiceOffering. A digital service available for order. Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the GaiaXEntity model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

aggregationOfResources.description: Relationship. Resources related to the entity that can exist independently of it. Links to one or more Resource entities.

providedBy.description: Relationship. The participant providing the service. Links to a LegalPerson entity.

dependsOn.description: Relationship. Service offerings related to the service. Links to one or more ServiceOffering entities.

serviceOfferingTermsAndConditions.description: Relationship. One or more Terms and Conditions applying to that service. Links to one or more TermsAndConditions entities.

servicePolicy.description: Relationship. One or more policies expressed using a DSL (e.g., Rego or ODRL). Links to one or more AccessUsagePolicy entities.

dataProtectionRegime.description: Property. One or more data protection regimes applying to the service offering. Controlled-vocabulary value (PersonalDataProtectionRegime), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

dataAccountExport.description: Relationship. One or more methods to export data out of the service. Links to one or more DataAccountExport entities.

keyword.description: Property. Keywords that describe/tag the service.

provisionType.description: Property. Provision type of the service. Controlled-vocabulary value (ProvisionTypes), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

endpoint.description: Relationship. Endpoint through which the Service Offering can be accessed. Links to an Endpoint entity.

hostedOn.description: Relationship. Resource(s) where the service is hosted and instantiated. Links to one or more VirtualResource or PhysicalResource entities.

serviceScope.description: Property. Plain text describing the service scope.

legalDocuments.description: Relationship. Legal documents in relation to the service or the customer. Links to one or more LegalDocument entities.

subContractors.description: Relationship. Sub-contractors processing customer data. Links to one or more SubContractor entities.

customerInstructions.description: Relationship. Customer instructions describing customer data guidance. Links to one or more CustomerInstructions entities.

dataPortability.description: Relationship. Data portability documents describing measures. Links to one or more DataPortability entities.

possiblePersonalDataTransfers.description: Relationship. Data transfer documents describing the extent of transfers. Links to one or more DataTransfer entities.

requiredMeasures.description: Relationship. Technical and organizational measures. Links to one or more Measure entities.

cryptographicSecurityStandards.description: Property. Cryptographic security standards protecting data. Controlled-vocabulary value (CryptographicSecurityStandards), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

providerContactInformation.description: Relationship. Contact information for reaching the service provider. Links to a ContactInformation entity.
